citation: E. H. Talbot. Talbot’s industry and railroad map of Chicago. Chicago, 1904. Scale ca. 1:25,000. North and southeast scans, University of Chicago Library.

access_notes: Read the original Zoomify tiles on 2026-10-14, not the catalogue description. North detail rectangle [13400,12100,14600,16456]; southeast detail [4400,0,6100,2000]. Geometry picks and registration are in data/terrain/epochs/e1871_postfire/context_spec.json.
what_it_supplies: 1904 railway corridor, terminal lands, lake edge, Grant Park fill and the 26th–28th Street railroad land projection.
The corridor continues southeast beyond 33rd Street on the southeast sheet.
what_it_does_not_supply: Individual track counts, gauge, switches, grades or shore construction.
A surveyed coordinate fit; registration and joins to the more detailed Sanborn reconstruction are approximate.
Exact completion dates of the Grant Park filling labelled Being filled up.
